== Checklist == : ''See also: [[Zimel's Blades (SoulFire)]] Note, you will want Warmly faction with Bloodsabers before turnin to Lord Grimrot, Heretics before turn in to Jotayi Ibupran, etc. If you click your burning soul, and it still gives you text, you have not completed the turn in likely due to faction issues.{{CheckboxList}} * Prepare these items first! ** Obtain a [[SoulFire]] ** Obtain a [[Dark Reaver]] * Slay [[Brother Hayle]] ** Loot and click on soul * Find [[Lord Grimrot]] - MUST BE LIVING VERSION! ** Give Lord Grimrot Dark Reaver and clicked [[Burning Soul of the Pious]] - requires [[Bloodsabers]] Kindly Faction ** Kill Lord Grimrot * Find [[Jotayi Ibupran]] in [[Paineel]] ** Give Jotayi Ibupran [[Pestilence Scythe]] (with charges, not uncharged) and [[Burning Soul of the Pestilent]] - requires [[Heretics]] Warmly Faction * Find [[Inte Akera]] ** Give [[Dason Goldblade]] 500pp to spawn Inte Akera -- '''Doing so will spawn Inte Akera in the Windmill on Island 4. Inte is a Deepwater Knight of Prexus and will unleash the Oceanlord's fury upon those deemed 'evil' in their eyes. Inte Akera only stays up for a few minutes, so hustle.''' ** Kill [[Inte Akera]] and loot the [[Burning Soul of the Virtuous]]. * Give [[Luxio Nulsis]] in East Freeport the three souls and [[Soulfire]]. Requires [[Dismal Rage]] kindly faction! [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Plane of Sky]] [[Category:Paladin Quests]] [[Category:Shadow Knight Quests]]
